first_action: Match Groq versus OpenRouter, rotate exposed keys, paste one fresh provider key locally, and retest one short text prompt.
avoid: Do not post the API key or reinstall the same jar for a credential error.

likely_layer: Account, organization, model, route, content, or permission restriction
first_action: Check model access, provider permissions, account restrictions, and any guardrail or moderation message.
avoid: Do not treat 403 as the same problem as a missing key.

likely_layer: Model ID, endpoint, or route configuration
first_action: Open the current provider model list and select a model supported by the installed Verity build.
avoid: Do not use model IDs copied from old videos without checking the provider.

likely_layer: Request, token, audio, image, or daily rate limit
first_action: Stop retries, inspect the provider limits page, wait for the reset window, then test one short text prompt.
avoid: Do not create repeated keys in the same organization as a quota fix.

likely_layer: Provider availability, upstream route, or temporary capacity
first_action: Wait, check provider status or model availability, and retry one short text prompt later.
avoid: Do not rotate a valid key for a service availability error.

likely_layer: Local service, host, port, firewall, or missing local model
first_action: Start Ollama, confirm it answers outside Minecraft, and match the exact local endpoint and model in the Verity profile.
avoid: Do not search for a cloud key when the route is local Ollama.

likely_layer: Model output, profile configuration, local service, integration log, or voice layer
first_action: Test one short typed prompt, compare model names and endpoints, and read a sanitized launcher or mod log.
avoid: Do not diagnose voice until text succeeds.

status_or_symptom: Text works but voice does not
likely_layer: Speech recognition, TTS, device, language, voice dependency, or audio limit
first_action: Keep the provider setup unchanged and move to microphone, TTS, output device, language, and voice dependency checks.
avoid: Do not rotate a working API key for a voice-only failure.
